My husband and I farm this small piece near our home, and maize is what feeds our children so I must try my best with it. I managed to get a FISP coupon last year and I am hoping again this season, so I will put a little chemical fertilizer and also the manure from our goats to help the soil. I plant hybrid seed when I can get it through the coupon, and I intercrop with pigeon pea to help with the soil and give us some relish. The plot is very small so I do not need to hire people — I and my older children can manage the weeding and ridging ourselves.
